answer: Stop sybils with a vault vertex trellis: an agent stakes a bond for one vault. Each cycle it files a vertex proof at its trellis crossing; verifiers match the vertex to the trellis lattice, voiding a vault whose proof is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 vaults at 18x: each vertex fits one vault and one trellis, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents file once and keep rights.
